name: bluechew-automation
description: Playwright TypeScript automation framework for BlueChew

scripts.test:dev: cross-env ENV_TYPE=dev npx playwright test src/specs
scripts.test:prod: cross-env ENV_TYPE=prod npx playwright test src/specs
scripts.test:ci: cross-env ENV_TYPE=ci npx playwright test src/specs
scripts.test:demo: cross-env ENV_TYPE=demo npx playwright test src/specs
scripts.test:smoke: cross-env ENV_TYPE=dev npx playwright test src/specs --grep "@smoke"
scripts.test:regression: cross-env ENV_TYPE=dev npx playwright test src/specs --grep "@regression"
scripts.test:login: cross-env ENV_TYPE=dev npx playwright test src/specs/login/login.spec.ts
scripts.test:login:mobile: cross-env ENV_TYPE=dev npx playwright test src/specs/login/login.spec.ts --project=chromium-mobile
scripts.test:profile: cross-env ENV_TYPE=dev npx playwright test src/specs/login/profile.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:core: cross-env ENV_TYPE=dev npx playwright test src/specs/login src/specs/medical src/specs/registration src/specs/product/footer-redirects.spec.ts
scripts.test:product:sildenafil: cross-env ENV_TYPE=dev npx playwright test src/specs/product/product-checkout.spec.ts --grep PRODUCT-SILDENAFIL
scripts.test:product:tadalafil: cross-env ENV_TYPE=dev npx playwright test src/specs/product/product-checkout.spec.ts --grep PRODUCT-TADALAFIL
scripts.test:product:vardenafil: cross-env ENV_TYPE=dev npx playwright test src/specs/product/product-checkout.spec.ts --grep PRODUCT-VARDENAFIL
scripts.test:product:dailytad: cross-env ENV_TYPE=dev npx playwright test src/specs/product/product-checkout.spec.ts --grep PRODUCT-DAILYTAD
scripts.test:product:max: cross-env ENV_TYPE=dev npx playwright test src/specs/product/product-checkout.spec.ts --grep PRODUCT-MAX
scripts.test:product:vmax: cross-env ENV_TYPE=dev npx playwright test src/specs/product/product-checkout.spec.ts --grep PRODUCT-VMAX
scripts.test:product:gold: cross-env ENV_TYPE=dev npx playwright test src/specs/product/product-checkout.spec.ts --grep PRODUCT-GOLD
scripts.test:landing:max: cross-env ENV_TYPE=dev npx playwright test src/specs/product/landing-max.spec.ts
scripts.test:landing:max:headed: cross-env ENV_TYPE=dev npx playwright test src/specs/product/landing-max.spec.ts --headed
scripts.test:landing:max:ui: cross-env ENV_TYPE=dev npx playwright test src/specs/product/landing-max.spec.ts --ui
scripts.test:landing:max:debug: cross-env ENV_TYPE=dev npx playwright test src/specs/product/landing-max.spec.ts --debug
scripts.test:mobile:sildenafil: cross-env ENV_TYPE=dev npx playwright test src/specs/product/product-checkout.spec.ts --project=chromium-mobile --grep PRODUCT-SILDENAFIL
scripts.test:mobile:tadalafil: cross-env ENV_TYPE=dev npx playwright test src/specs/product/product-checkout.spec.ts --project=chromium-mobile --grep PRODUCT-TADALAFIL
scripts.test:mobile:vardenafil: cross-env ENV_TYPE=dev npx playwright test src/specs/product/product-checkout.spec.ts --project=chromium-mobile --grep PRODUCT-VARDENAFIL
scripts.test:mobile:dailytad: cross-env ENV_TYPE=dev npx playwright test src/specs/product/product-checkout.spec.ts --project=chromium-mobile --grep PRODUCT-DAILYTAD
scripts.test:mobile:max: cross-env ENV_TYPE=dev npx playwright test src/specs/product/product-checkout.spec.ts --project=chromium-mobile --grep PRODUCT-MAX
scripts.test:mobile:vmax: cross-env ENV_TYPE=dev npx playwright test src/specs/product/product-checkout.spec.ts --project=chromium-mobile --grep PRODUCT-VMAX
scripts.allure:report: npm run allure:generate && npm run allure:open
